messages:
Ravi: Quick poll for Sat morning energy: farmers market at 8am (I want the sourdough), an improv jam at 6pm (no experience required), or a mini-office fridge cleanup + potluck at 11am? Low stakes voting. :seedling: :performing_arts: :fork_and_knife:

Hannah: Farmers market for me  Im bringing reusable bags. Anyone want to split an extra loaf?

Carmen: Improv jam sounds wild  I can teach a 10-min warmup if we have enough folks. Also I call dibs on the first improv prompt ">awkward elevator silence" :joy:

Leo: Fridge cleanup + potluck  Ill bring apologies and compostable plates. Also we should clear expired condiments  theres a mystery jar labeled "salsa-ish" thats been in there since Feb.

Ravi: Ha mystery salsa. Official emoji vote: react with :seedling: for market, :performing_arts: for improv, :fork_and_knife: for cleanup. Ill tally at 5pm and set a plan.

InternBot: Heads up: office recycling pickup is Sat 12:00. Please bag and label heavy items. :recycle:

Hannah: :seedling: (also who wants a slice of the cinnamon crumb Im bringing?)

Carmen: :performing_arts: (Ill bring a few improv prompts and a bluetooth speaker)

Leo: :fork_and_knife: (I have a bag of napkins and a trash grabber)

Ravi: Current split looks even. If market wins Ill DM a meetup spot by the fountain. If cleanup wins well start at 11:15 to let people commute. If improv wins, Carmen you get to pick the warm-up.

Hannah: Also side note for Friday night: if anyone wants to carpool to the 45min yoga class at 7, say so. I can drive 2.

Ravi: Nice. Ill post the final plan at 5pm. Enjoy the rest of today folks :sun_with_face:
